name: BTC Post-Fixing Session Fade
description: Trades one BTC 15-minute window a day: the one that opens at 4:00 pm New York time on US trading days. If BTC moved a lot since the 9:30 am stock-market open, buy the side that bets on part of that move coming back. The session's flow (ETF creations filled into the 3-4 pm fixing, the stock close) stops at 4:00 and the move partly reverts, but Kalshi opens that window near 50/50.
hypothesis: US-session flow (spot-ETF creations/redemptions traded into the 15:00-16:00 ET CF fixing, CME settlement and the equity close at 16:00) pushes BTC with the session; at 16:00 the pressure stops and part reverts. Losers: opening takers/quoters pricing the 16:00 window as driftless. Found post hoc in a slot scan (H2 was momentum in the fixing hour, wrong sign): corr(session return, 16:00 window return) -0.36/-0.33 BTC, also ETH/SOL; fade at next real fills +11c in both halves. Wrong if the full walk-forward isn't promising or the lockbox loses.
